g.text: Figure 14. Quality across normalized problem progress
Inspired by paper Figure 3 (v2). Linear interpolation to five positions; equal weight per problem. Three trajectories/model; no confidence intervals.
Models ordered by public API release date, newest first; same-day ties alphabetically.
